# Recommendations

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Scenarios tagged `@recommendation` test our own best practice, beyond what WCAG requires. They use the same shared steps as the success criteria.

## Setup

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.
- [`When I enable "<requested-mode>" mode`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Changes the colour mode in the browser. For example: light, dark, forced colours.
- [`When I view the rendered "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-viewed.js) — Checks an element is visibly rendered on the page.
- [`When I preview the page for printing`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Previews the page as it would print, so print styles apply
- [`When I inspect "<selector>" in the DOM`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-inspected.js) — Checks element exists in the DOM, regardless of visibility on the page.
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button
- [`When I navigate to the fragment "<fragment>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/navigation-occurs.js) — Navigates to an anchor on the current page, as following a link to it would
- [`When I press the "<key>" key once`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/keyboard-events-occur.js) — Presses a key on the keyboard.
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using a keyboard`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element using the keyboard. Note: Will activate :focus-visible styles.
- [`When I inspect "<selector>" in the Accessibility Tree`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-inspected.js) — Checks an element exists in the accessibility tree.
- [`When I set the viewport to <width>px wide`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Sets the viewport width in the browser.
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using the arrow keys`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element inside a component using arrow keys. For example: Components which use a roving tabindex pattern. Note: Will activate :focus-visible) styles.

## Assertions

- [`Then it should not lose any content or functionality`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks nothing was lost after a user setting changed, such as zoom, text spacing, orientation, a user stylesheet or forced colours. Note: Fails on clipped text, overlapping content, horizontal scrolling, collapsed or covered controls, and ignored user stylesheet preferences.
- [`Then it should have the CSS property "<prop>" with the value "<value>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks if an element has a certain CSS property and value.
- [`Then it should have the attribute "<attribute>" with the value "<value>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element has a particular attribute and value.
- [`Then it should use valid HTML with no parsing errors`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks the HTML is valid.
- [`Then it should be nested within the "<ancestor-selector>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element is a descendant of another element.
- [`Then it should use the tag "<tag>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element uses a specific HTML tag.
- [`Then it is positioned after the "<previous-el>" element in the DOM`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automaically checks if an element is positioned after another in the DOM.
- [`Then it should be to the left of the text in the "<reference>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element sits entirely to the left of the visible text in another element. Note: Use for icons which should appear before a label.
- [`Then it should have the attribute "<attribute>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element has a particular attribute Note: The value is not checked in this test
- [`Then it should have an accessible name`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element just has an accessible name.
- [`Then its accessible name should be "<accessible-name>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks the accessible name matches a given string.
- [`Then it should be visually identifiable as a link without relying on colour alone`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks a link for a reliance on colour. Note: Checks for underlines, borders and font-weight
- [`Then it should have a visible separator between elements using a '::before' element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks if an element has a CSS pseudo separator.
- [`Then it is "<position>" aligned visually to the "<previous>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks if elements are visually aligned.
- [`Then it should not have the attribute "<attribute>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element does NOT have a particular attribute
- [`Then it should have a visible focus indicator`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a visible focus indicator. Note: Only checks for for outline or box-shadow.
- [`Then its focus indicator should have a minimum perimiter thickness of 2px`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks the thickess of the focus indicator.
- [`Then it should have an accessible role of "<role>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a particular role.
- [`Then "<selector>" should be focused`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element is currently focused.
- [`Then it should contain the text "<text>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element's text includes some expected text, including text which is visually hidden.
- [`Then it should not contain the text "<text>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element's text does not include some text, including text which is visually hidden.

## Scenarios

- Accordion: Content and information remain visible and understandable when using high contrast themes ([adaptability.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/adaptability.feature))
- Accordion: Collapsed sections are shown when the page is printed, without the Show all sections button ([adaptability.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/adaptability.feature))
- Accordion: The trigger is associated with the content it controls, using the aria-controls attribute ([assistive-technologies-and-semantics.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/assistive-technologies-and-semantics.feature))
- Accordion: The Show all sections button is associated with every section it controls, using the aria-controls attribute ([assistive-technologies-and-semantics.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/assistive-technologies-and-semantics.feature))
- Accordion: Markup can be parsed without errors ([assistive-technologies-and-semantics.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/assistive-technologies-and-semantics.feature))
- Accordion: The chevron icon is inside each trigger, before its label ([consistency-and-predictability.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/consistency-and-predictability.feature))
- Accordion: The chevron icon is inside the Show all sections button, before its label ([consistency-and-predictability.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/consistency-and-predictability.feature))
- Accordion: The down pointing chevron is to the left of each trigger's label ([consistency-and-predictability.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/consistency-and-predictability.feature))
- Accordion: In the one-at-a-time variant, activating the open section collapses it, leaving no section open ([consistency-and-predictability.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/consistency-and-predictability.feature))
- Accordion: Collapsed sections are hidden until found, so find in page can reveal them ([navigation.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/navigation.feature))
- Accordion: Following a link to an anchor inside a collapsed section expands that section only ([navigation.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/navigation.feature))
- Accordion: Opening the page at an anchor inside a section of a one at a time accordion opens that section instead of the first ([navigation.feature](../../src/components/accordion/features/navigation.feature))
